units.title: Unit 1 — Schwa, Syllable Stress & Stress Shifts

lessons.title: Schwa — The Unstressed Vowel & Reduced Function Words
grammar: Vowel reduction to schwa in unstressed syllables and function words
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-B1-001"
cando: "Can produce schwa in unstressed syllables and weak forms of function words."
task: "Identify and mark schwa sounds in connected sentences."
speaking_focus: "Relaxed central vowel articulation."

lessons.title: Word Stress Rules (Nouns/Adjectives vs Verbs/Prepositions)
grammar: Default stress patterns for two-syllable words by grammatical category
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-B1-002"
cando: "Can apply first-syllable noun stress and second-syllable verb stress defaults."
task: "Classify 2-syllable words and clap stressed syllables."
speaking_focus: "Vowel length and pitch jump on stressed syllables."

lessons.title: Stress-Shifting Heteronyms (RECord vs reCORD)
grammar: Grammatical category shift signaled exclusively by primary stress position
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-B1-003"
cando: "Can shift stress and vowel quality between noun and verb heteronym pairs."
task: "Sentence pairs contrasting REcord (noun) and reCORD (verb)."
speaking_focus: "Vowel reduction to schwa when stress shifts away."

units.title: Unit 2 — Multi-Syllable Stress, Open/Closed & Complex Patterns

lessons.title: Multi-Syllable Stress Suffix Rules (-tion, -ic, -ty, -ee)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-B1-004"
cando: "Can predict stress placement in multi-syllable derivative words."
task: "Mark primary stress using suffix rule heuristics."
speaking_focus: "Rhythmic accentuation in long words."

lessons.title: S Voicing & X Pronunciation Patterns
grammar: Voicing of S between vowels/after voiced sounds and X pronunciations
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-B1-005"
cando: "Can apply S voicing rules and predict X pronunciation based on stress."
task: "Contrast box vs examine."
speaking_focus: "Voiced /z/ vs voiceless /s/ control."

lessons.title: The OUGH & GH Complex Patterns
grammar: Decoding the 6 main pronunciations of OUGH and silent/f-sound GH
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-B1-006"
cando: "Can categorize and pronounce high-frequency OUGH and GH words accurately."
task: "Read OUGH sentences demonstrating sound variants."
speaking_focus: "Memorized decoding of non-rule-governed letter teams."
